name: THE GENERATION — World & Physics
objective: Integrate World Labs API for procedural world generation, implement all 6 Kinetic Verbs with Rapier physics, connect PIP bio-feedback for responsive rendering, and build Aletheos/Pichet Witness Agent physics modifiers.

tasks.title: Create FastAPI project scaffold with uvicorn, pydantic, CORS middleware
tasks.deliverable: FastAPI application boots with CORS enabled, health endpoint returns 200, pydantic settings loaded from env vars.
tasks.acceptance: Running uvicorn main:app starts server on port 8000 and GET /health returns status ok.

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database with sessions, worlds, readings, artifacts tables
tasks.deliverable: PostgreSQL schema with sessions, worlds, readings, and artifacts tables created via migration script.
tasks.acceptance: Running the migration creates all 4 tables and a SELECT on each returns zero rows without error.

tasks.title: Implement SQLAlchemy ORM models for all database tables
tasks.deliverable: SQLAlchemy ORM model classes for Session, World, Reading, and Artifact with relationships and type annotations.
tasks.acceptance: Creating and querying a Session with related World via ORM succeeds without raw SQL.

tasks.title: Build JWT authentication system for API endpoints
tasks.deliverable: JWT-based auth with login, token refresh, and protected route decorator implemented.
tasks.acceptance: A request without valid JWT to a protected endpoint returns 401 and a request with valid JWT returns 200.

tasks.title: Create World Labs API client: prompt submission, generation polling, asset download
tasks.deliverable: Async client class that submits prompts, polls generation status, and downloads .glb and .splat assets on completion.
tasks.acceptance: Client submits a test prompt and returns downloaded asset bytes within the polling timeout period.

tasks.title: Build prompt construction system: Dasha planet + archetype to biome description text
tasks.deliverable: Function that takes a Dasha planet enum and archetype string and returns a formatted World Labs prompt string.
tasks.acceptance: Calling construct_prompt with Saturn and seeker returns a non-empty string containing both biome keywords and archetype modifiers.

tasks.title: Create 9 Planetary Dasha biome prompt templates (Saturn=obsidian void, Venus=crystalline garden, etc.)
tasks.deliverable: JSON file with 9 Dasha biome templates containing material keywords, atmosphere description, and lighting direction per planet.
tasks.acceptance: All 9 planetary Dasha entries (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) exist and each has non-empty prompt_template field.

tasks.title: Implement server-side collision mesh extraction from generated .glb worlds
tasks.deliverable: Pipeline that parses .glb, extracts terrain geometry, simplifies to low-poly collision mesh, and exports as separate .glb.
tasks.acceptance: A generated world .glb produces a collision mesh .glb with less than 5000 triangles and matching XZ bounds.

tasks.title: Build splat compression pipeline: downsample + quantize generated Gaussian data
tasks.deliverable: Pipeline that takes raw Gaussian splat data, downsamples by configurable factor, and quantizes SH coefficients to 8-bit.
tasks.acceptance: Compressed splat file is less than 40% the size of the original with PSNR above 30dB on test scene.

tasks.title: Create progressive client-side world loader (blurry to sharp materialization)
tasks.deliverable: React component that streams splat data in LOD tiers, rendering blurry approximation first then refining to full quality.
tasks.acceptance: World visually appears within 1 second as blurry and reaches full quality within 5 seconds on a 50Mbps connection.

tasks.title: Implement ground ripple vertex shader (radial displacement wave from center)
tasks.deliverable: GLSL vertex shader that displaces ground mesh vertices in a radial sinusoidal wave expanding from a configurable origin point.
tasks.acceptance: Shader produces a visible ripple expanding outward from center at configurable speed without mesh artifacts.

tasks.title: Build world reveal: progressive splat loading with distance-based alpha mask
tasks.deliverable: Alpha mask shader that reveals splats from center outward based on distance, synced to loading progress.
tasks.acceptance: Splats fade in from center with smooth alpha gradient and no visible seam at the reveal boundary.

tasks.title: Create four cardinal direction glow effects (shader atmospheric lights)
tasks.deliverable: Four directional glow post-processing effects at N/E/S/W positions with configurable color and intensity per zone.
tasks.acceptance: All four cardinal glows render at correct world-space positions and change color when zone config is updated.

tasks.title: Build Cartographer path trail (fading splat particles leading toward Breathfield)
tasks.deliverable: Particle trail system using splat-style rendering that creates a fading path from vessel position toward the Breathfield zone.
tasks.acceptance: Trail particles render along a spline path, fade over 3 seconds, and update direction when Breathfield position changes.

tasks.title: Implement pre-cached fallback worlds (static .splat + .glb for all 9 Dashas)
tasks.deliverable: 9 pre-generated static world bundles stored in CDN-ready format with matching collision meshes.
tasks.acceptance: Each of the 9 Dasha fallback worlds loads successfully client-side when World Labs API is unreachable.

tasks.title: Build world state persistence (save generated world_id + config to PostgreSQL + IndexedDB)
tasks.deliverable: Dual persistence layer saving world generation results server-side in PostgreSQL and client-side in IndexedDB for offline access.
tasks.acceptance: After generating a world, refreshing the page loads the same world from IndexedDB without a new API call.

tasks.title: Create world generation orchestration endpoint: POST /api/worlds/generate
tasks.deliverable: REST endpoint that accepts Dasha + archetype, orchestrates World Labs generation, and returns world assets URL.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/worlds/generate with valid Dasha returns 202 with job_id, and polling GET /api/worlds/{job_id} eventually returns asset URLs.

tasks.title: Build World Labs API mock server for offline development (all 9 Dashas pre-generated)
tasks.deliverable: Mock server that mimics World Labs API responses with pre-generated assets for all 9 Dasha biomes.
tasks.acceptance: Mock server responds to prompt submission and returns pre-generated assets with realistic polling delays.

tasks.title: Implement world generation retry with simplified prompt on API failure
tasks.deliverable: Retry logic that simplifies the prompt on World Labs API failure up to 3 attempts then falls back to cached world.
tasks.acceptance: On simulated API failure, system retries with progressively simpler prompts and falls back to cached world after 3 failures.

tasks.title: Create world generation cost estimator (track API calls per user in PostgreSQL)
tasks.deliverable: Database tracking of API call count, estimated cost, and per-user usage statistics with admin query endpoint.
tasks.acceptance: After 5 generation calls, GET /api/admin/usage returns accurate count and estimated cost for the test user.

tasks.title: Build progressive world reveal timing controller (ripple to materialize to glows to trail sequence)
tasks.deliverable: Timeline controller that orchestrates the world reveal sequence: ripple(0-1s), materialize(0.5-3s), glows(2-3.5s), trail(3-5s).
tasks.acceptance: World reveal plays the complete 4-stage sequence in order with smooth overlapping transitions totaling under 5 seconds.

tasks.title: Create world biome metadata schema (material keywords, lighting preset, fog config per biome)
tasks.deliverable: TypeScript type and JSON schema defining biome metadata including material_keywords, lighting_preset, fog_density, fog_color, ambient_color.
tasks.acceptance: All 9 biome metadata entries validate against the schema and contain all required fields with correct types.

tasks.title: Implement collision mesh loading into Rapier (generated .glb to trimesh collider)
tasks.deliverable: Loader that parses collision mesh .glb, extracts vertices and indices, and creates a Rapier trimesh collider.
tasks.acceptance: A dynamic rigid body dropped onto the loaded trimesh collider rests on the terrain surface without falling through.

tasks.title: Build world LOD system: distance-based quality for generated terrain splats
tasks.deliverable: LOD manager that swaps splat quality tiers based on camera distance with hysteresis to prevent thrashing.
tasks.acceptance: Moving camera from near to far reduces rendered splat count by at least 60% with no visible pop-in.

tasks.title: Create FastAPI health check and readiness endpoints
tasks.deliverable: GET /health (liveness) and GET /ready (readiness checking DB + World Labs API connectivity) endpoints.
tasks.acceptance: GET /health returns 200 always, GET /ready returns 200 when DB is connected and 503 when DB is down.

tasks.title: Implement FastAPI request logging and error tracking middleware
tasks.deliverable: Middleware that logs request method, path, status code, duration, and captures unhandled exceptions with stack traces.
tasks.acceptance: Every API request produces a structured JSON log line and unhandled exceptions are logged with full traceback.

tasks.title: Build database migration system with Alembic
tasks.deliverable: Alembic configuration with initial migration, auto-generation support, and upgrade/downgrade scripts.
tasks.acceptance: Running alembic upgrade head on empty database creates all tables and alembic downgrade -1 cleanly removes the last migration.

tasks.title: Create API documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger auto-generation
tasks.deliverable: Auto-generated OpenAPI spec accessible at /docs with all endpoints, request/response schemas, and auth requirements documented.
tasks.acceptance: Navigating to /docs shows interactive Swagger UI with all API endpoints and executing a test request returns valid response.

tasks.title: Implement world generation rate limiting (1 world/user/hour, serve cached for repeats)
tasks.deliverable: Rate limiter that restricts world generation to 1 per user per hour and returns cached world data for repeated Dasha requests.
tasks.acceptance: Second generation request within 1 hour returns 429 with cached world URL, and request after 1 hour succeeds.

tasks.title: Build integration test: Dasha input to world loads progressively within 5 seconds
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end test that submits a Dasha, waits for generation, loads world client-side, and asserts progressive reveal completes.
tasks.acceptance: Test passes asserting world is visually loaded (first splat rendered) within 5 seconds of generation completion.

tasks.title: Implement GRASP verb: spring joint creation between vessel and object on hold gesture
tasks.deliverable: GRASP verb that creates a Rapier spring joint between the vessel and target object when a hold gesture is detected.
tasks.acceptance: Holding gesture near a dynamic object creates a spring joint that visually connects vessel to object with elastic behavior.

tasks.title: Implement THROW verb: velocity transfer from hand to object on release, magnitude from hand speed
tasks.deliverable: THROW verb that transfers hand velocity to the grasped object on release, scaling impulse by tracked hand speed.
tasks.acceptance: Releasing a grasped object with hand moving at greater than 2m/s applies proportional impulse and object travels in hand direction.

tasks.title: Implement ORBIT verb: spherical joint constraining object to vessel orbit on two-hand gesture
tasks.deliverable: ORBIT verb that creates a spherical joint constraining an object to orbit the vessel at a fixed radius on two-hand gesture.
tasks.acceptance: Two-hand gesture causes target object to orbit vessel at constant radius with orbit speed proportional to hand separation.

tasks.title: Implement STRIKE verb: collision detection + momentum threshold (12.0 base), 4 outcome tiers
tasks.deliverable: STRIKE verb with momentum-based collision detection and 4 outcome tiers: Perfect(>20), Adequate(12-20), Weak(5-12), Reckless(>30).
tasks.acceptance: Striking an object with momentum 15.0 triggers Adequate tier and momentum 25.0 triggers Perfect tier with correct outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement BREATHE-SYNC verb: collider scale modulation from breath rate (coherence > 70 for 3 cycles)
tasks.deliverable: BREATHE-SYNC verb that modulates target collider scale based on breath rate when coherence exceeds 70 for 3 consecutive cycles.
tasks.acceptance: With coherence at 75 for 3 breath cycles, target object collider scale oscillates in sync with breath phase.

tasks.title: Implement REST verb: velocity timeout detection to transition RigidBody to Fixed type
tasks.deliverable: REST verb that detects when an object velocity stays below 0.1 for 2 seconds and transitions its RigidBody to Fixed.
tasks.acceptance: A dropped object that comes to rest transitions to Fixed type within 2 seconds and no longer responds to forces.

tasks.title: Build mouse/trackpad input mapping: click-hold=GRASP, release=THROW, right-drag=ORBIT, shift-click=STRIKE, scroll=BREATHE, double-click=REST
tasks.deliverable: Input handler mapping mouse and trackpad events to all 6 Kinetic Verbs with configurable keybindings.
tasks.acceptance: Each of the 6 mouse/trackpad inputs triggers the corresponding Kinetic Verb and no two inputs conflict.

tasks.title: Create object state machine: Dormant to Awakened to Active to Ritual to Integrated with transition rules
tasks.deliverable: Finite state machine for ritual objects with 5 states and validated transition rules preventing illegal state changes.
tasks.acceptance: Object transitions follow Dormant then Awakened then Active then Ritual then Integrated order and direct Dormant to Ritual is rejected.

tasks.title: Implement proximity wake system: objects within 10 units transition DORMANT to AWAKENED
tasks.deliverable: Spatial query system that checks vessel distance to dormant objects each frame and triggers Awakened transition within 10 units.
tasks.acceptance: Moving vessel within 10 units of a dormant object transitions it to Awakened within 1 frame and moving beyond 15 units reverts it.

tasks.title: Build state transition visual effects: scale oscillation for Awakened, glow for Active, dissolve for Integrated
tasks.deliverable: Visual effect system that applies distinct animations per object state: gentle scale pulse for Awakened, emissive glow for Active, dissolve particles for Integrated.
tasks.acceptance: Each of the 5 object states has a visually distinct effect and transitions between effects are smooth over 0.5 seconds.

tasks.title: Implement RigidBody type transitions per state: Fixed(dormant), Dynamic(active), KinematicPositionBased(ritual)
tasks.deliverable: System that changes Rapier RigidBody type when object state changes: Fixed for Dormant, Dynamic for Active, KinematicPositionBased for Ritual.
tasks.acceptance: Object in Dormant state ignores forces, in Active state responds to physics, and in Ritual state follows scripted position.

tasks.title: Build sleep/wake policy: objects >20u from vessel sleep, <10u wake
tasks.deliverable: Physics sleep policy that deactivates Rapier simulation for objects beyond 20 units and reactivates within 10 units of vessel.
tasks.acceptance: Objects at 25 units are sleeping (zero CPU cost) and objects at 8 units are actively simulated.

tasks.title: Create hand velocity tracker with rolling 5-frame buffer for THROW/STRIKE momentum calculation
tasks.deliverable: Rolling buffer tracking hand landmark positions over 5 frames to compute smoothed velocity vector for momentum-based verbs.
tasks.acceptance: Velocity tracker outputs stable velocity vector that matches hand movement direction and magnitude within 10% of manual measurement.

tasks.title: Build gesture-to-verb mapping: Open Palm=GRASP ready, Fist=HOLD, Swipe=THROW, Pinch=fine GRASP
tasks.deliverable: Gesture classifier that maps hand landmark configurations to Kinetic Verb intents with confidence thresholds.
tasks.acceptance: Each of the 4 gesture types is recognized with greater than 85% accuracy on a 50-sample test set per gesture.

tasks.title: Implement gesture debouncing: 150ms confirmation (5 frames at 30fps), 100ms release (3 frames)
tasks.deliverable: Debounce layer that requires gesture hold for 150ms before activation and 100ms of non-detection before release.
tasks.acceptance: Brief accidental gestures under 150ms do not trigger verbs and sustained gestures activate after exactly 150ms.

tasks.title: Build Mudra detection: Anjali (palms pressed) to invoke Breathfield, Chin (index-thumb pinch) to contemplation
tasks.deliverable: Two-hand mudra detector for Anjali (prayer) and Chin mudra poses using bilateral hand landmark comparison.
tasks.acceptance: Anjali mudra detected when palms face each other within 5cm and Chin mudra detected when index touches thumb tip on both hands.

tasks.title: Implement object hover highlighting: scale 1.1x + glow increase on raycast
tasks.deliverable: Raycast-based hover system that scales hovered objects to 1.1x and increases emissive intensity when pointer intersects.
tasks.acceptance: Hovering over an interactive object visually scales it up and adds glow, and moving away restores original appearance within 0.2s.

tasks.title: Build CCD (Continuous Collision Detection) for fast THROW/STRIKE (prevent tunneling)
tasks.deliverable: CCD enabled on all throwable/strikeable objects to prevent fast-moving bodies from passing through thin colliders.
tasks.acceptance: Object thrown at maximum velocity (50.0) at a thin wall collider does not tunnel through and registers collision.

tasks.title: Implement velocity multiplier cap at 50.0 (prevent physics explosion)
tasks.deliverable: Velocity clamping system that caps linear and angular velocity magnitudes at 50.0 units/second on all dynamic bodies.
tasks.acceptance: Applying an impulse that would produce velocity greater than 50.0 results in exactly 50.0 magnitude velocity with preserved direction.

tasks.title: Build STRIKE visual feedback: Perfect=Gold particles+shake, Adequate=Terracotta, Weak=bounce, Reckless=shatter
tasks.deliverable: 4-tier visual feedback system for STRIKE outcomes with distinct particle effects, colors, and camera reactions per tier.
tasks.acceptance: Each of the 4 STRIKE tiers produces visually distinct feedback and the correct tier triggers based on momentum value.

tasks.title: Create BREATHE-SYNC attunement timer with progressive glow (3 breath cycles to lock)
tasks.deliverable: Visual timer showing breath cycle progress toward attunement lock with progressive glow intensity per completed cycle.
tasks.acceptance: Glow increases by 33% per completed breath cycle and reaches full intensity after 3 cycles with visual lock confirmation.

tasks.title: Implement dissolve shader for INTEGRATED state (alpha to 0 over 5s + gold particles)
tasks.deliverable: GLSL dissolve shader that reduces object alpha to 0 over 5 seconds while emitting gold particle sprites from the surface.
tasks.acceptance: Object entering Integrated state dissolves smoothly over exactly 5 seconds with gold particles and no visual artifacts.

tasks.title: Build unit tests for all 6 Kinetic Verb physics calculations (30+ test cases)
tasks.deliverable: Test suite with 30+ unit tests covering all 6 Kinetic Verbs including edge cases and boundary conditions.
tasks.acceptance: All 30+ tests pass, covering at least 5 test cases per verb including nominal, boundary, and error conditions.

tasks.title: Implement two-hand detection for ORBIT verb (both hands Open Palm confidence > 0.80)
tasks.deliverable: Bilateral hand detector that confirms both hands are in Open Palm pose with confidence above 0.80 before activating ORBIT.
tasks.acceptance: ORBIT activates only when both hands show Open Palm at greater than 0.80 confidence and deactivates when either drops below 0.70.

tasks.title: Build gesture/mouse input mode toggle (seamless switch, active joints transferred)
tasks.deliverable: Input mode toggle that seamlessly switches between gesture and mouse control, transferring any active physics joints.
tasks.acceptance: Switching from gesture to mouse mid-GRASP preserves the spring joint and object follows mouse cursor without dropping.

tasks.title: Create object pickup audio (mass-dependent resonant frequency: heavy=low, light=high)
tasks.deliverable: Audio system that plays a resonant tone on object pickup with frequency inversely proportional to object mass.
tasks.acceptance: Picking up a heavy object (mass greater than 10) plays tone below 200Hz and light object (mass less than 1) plays tone above 800Hz.

tasks.title: Build Kinetic Verb state machine: idle to ready to active to cooldown (prevent simultaneous verbs)
tasks.deliverable: Global verb state machine that ensures only one Kinetic Verb is active at a time with 200ms cooldown between activations.
tasks.acceptance: Attempting to activate THROW while GRASP is active is rejected and activating THROW after GRASP release respects 200ms cooldown.

tasks.title: Implement haptic-like screen edge vibration on GRASP and STRIKE (CSS animation feedback)
tasks.deliverable: CSS animation system that vibrates screen edges on GRASP activation and STRIKE impact using transform and box-shadow.
tasks.acceptance: GRASP shows subtle edge glow pulse and STRIKE shows brief screen shake proportional to momentum tier.

tasks.title: Create collision sound library (6 material pairs: stone-stone, stone-metal, cloth-rustle, etc.)
tasks.deliverable: Audio library with collision sounds for 6 material pairs with velocity-based volume and pitch modulation.
tasks.acceptance: Collisions between objects with different material tags play the correct material-pair sound with volume scaling by impact force.

tasks.title: Build object inventory system: track grasped items, max 2 simultaneous
tasks.deliverable: Inventory tracker that maintains list of currently grasped objects with a maximum of 2 simultaneous holds.
tasks.acceptance: Grasping a 3rd object while holding 2 is rejected with visual feedback and releasing one allows grasping a new one.

tasks.title: Implement proximity sensor debug visualization (range circles around dormant objects)
tasks.deliverable: Debug overlay showing wake radius (10u) and sleep radius (20u) circles around dormant objects when debug mode is active.
tasks.acceptance: Enabling debug mode shows concentric circles at 10u and 20u around each dormant object with color indicating wake state.

tasks.title: Build object element tag system: fire, water, earth, air, void assignments
tasks.deliverable: Tagging system that assigns one of 5 elemental types (fire, water, earth, air, void) to each ritual object.
tasks.acceptance: Every ritual object has exactly one element tag and querying objects by element returns the correct subset.

tasks.title: Create ritual object spawn system: place objects at predefined positions per zone
tasks.deliverable: Spawn system that places ritual objects at predefined world-space positions based on zone configuration data.
tasks.acceptance: Entering a zone spawns the correct set of ritual objects at their configured positions within 0.5 units of target.

tasks.title: Implement object persistence: remember object states across zone transitions
tasks.deliverable: Zustand persistence layer that saves object states (position, rotation, FSM state) when leaving a zone and restores on return.
tasks.acceptance: Moving an object to Active state, leaving the zone, and returning finds the object in Active state at its last position.

tasks.title: Build integration test: pick up, throw, orbit, place, and strike a test cube
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end integration test that exercises all 5 primary verbs on a test cube in sequence and validates physics outcomes.
tasks.acceptance: Test passes executing GRASP, THROW, ORBIT, REST, and STRIKE in sequence with correct state transitions and physics responses.

tasks.title: Connect real PIP Analysis Engine: WebSocket/SSE stream of coherence, LQD, entropy, breath_phase
tasks.deliverable: WebSocket client connecting to PIP Analysis Engine that receives and parses real-time coherence, LQD, entropy, and breath_phase values.
tasks.acceptance: Client receives live PIP data at greater than 10Hz and parsed values match the PIP dashboard output within 1% tolerance.

tasks.title: Implement breathfield flow field shader (GLSL): splat movement driven by breath rate and LQD
tasks.deliverable: GLSL fragment/vertex shader that displaces breathfield splats along a flow field whose speed and turbulence respond to breath rate and LQD.
tasks.acceptance: Breathfield splats visibly accelerate with higher breath rate and flow becomes smoother (less turbulence) as LQD increases.

tasks.title: Wire live coherence score to LinearDamping for real-time viscosity tuning
tasks.deliverable: System that maps live coherence score (0-100) to Rapier LinearDamping (0.1-2.0) for all dynamic bodies in the breathfield zone.
tasks.acceptance: Coherence at 90 produces low damping (0.2, fluid movement) and coherence at 20 produces high damping (1.8, viscous movement).

tasks.title: Implement post-processing with PIP uniforms: ChromaticAberration scales 0 to 0.5 with entropy
tasks.deliverable: Post-processing pass that maps PIP entropy value (0-100) to ChromaticAberration intensity (0-0.5) via shader uniform.
tasks.acceptance: Entropy at 0 shows no chromatic aberration and entropy at 100 shows maximum 0.5 aberration offset with smooth interpolation.

tasks.title: Build biome transition shaders (dissolve between Dasha worlds on transit change)
tasks.deliverable: Noise-based dissolve shader that transitions between two Dasha world splat scenes with configurable dissolve pattern and duration.
tasks.acceptance: Triggering a biome transition produces a smooth dissolve over 3 seconds with no visible seams or z-fighting.

tasks.title: Implement Aletheos friction modifier: coherence >70 for 30/60/120s produces friction 0.8/0.5/0.3
tasks.deliverable: Aletheos Witness Agent that tracks sustained coherence duration above 70 and steps down global friction at 30s, 60s, and 120s thresholds.
tasks.acceptance: Maintaining coherence above 70 for 35 seconds sets friction to 0.8, for 65 seconds to 0.5, and for 125 seconds to 0.3.

tasks.title: Implement Pichet gravity modifier: physical cycle >70/50-70/30-50/<30 produces gravity 1.0/1.3/1.8/2.5x
tasks.deliverable: Pichet Witness Agent that reads physical cycle score and adjusts global gravity multiplier across 4 tiers.
tasks.acceptance: Physical cycle score of 75 sets gravity to 1.0x, score of 60 sets 1.3x, score of 40 sets 1.8x, and score of 20 sets 2.5x.

tasks.title: Build Gate Check Protocol: combined Aletheos + Pichet evaluation before ritual activation
tasks.deliverable: Gate check system that evaluates both Aletheos friction level and Pichet gravity level before allowing ritual state transition.
tasks.acceptance: Ritual activation is blocked when Aletheos friction is above 0.6 OR Pichet gravity is above 1.5x and allowed when both conditions are met.

tasks.title: Implement collision event system: proximity_wake, ritual_activation, zone_transition, resonance_check, settle
tasks.deliverable: Event bus for 5 collision event types dispatched from Rapier contact callbacks with typed payloads.
tasks.acceptance: Each of the 5 event types fires with correct payload when its trigger condition occurs and listeners receive events within 1 frame.

tasks.title: Build elemental affinity resonance table: Fire+Fire=amplify, Fire+Water=dissonance, Earth+Earth=ground, Air+Any=lift, Fire+Earth=forge_resonance
tasks.deliverable: 5x5 elemental resonance lookup table that returns interaction type and physics modifier when two elemental objects collide.
tasks.acceptance: Fire+Fire collision returns amplify modifier (2x force), Fire+Water returns dissonance (opposing forces), and all 25 pairs have defined outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement zone boundary transition: gravity(2s lerp), fog(2s ease), color(1.5s HSL), audio(3s crossfade), bloom(instant)
tasks.deliverable: Multi-parameter zone transition system that interpolates gravity, fog, color palette, audio, and bloom across zone boundaries at specified rates.
tasks.acceptance: Crossing a zone boundary produces smooth gravity lerp over 2s, fog ease over 2s, HSL color shift over 1.5s, audio crossfade over 3s, and instant bloom change.

tasks.title: Build comprehensive performance profiling under full bio-data + physics + splat load
tasks.deliverable: Performance profiling harness that measures frame time, GPU time, physics step time, and memory under full system load.
tasks.acceptance: Profiler captures all 4 metrics per frame for 60 seconds and generates a report with min/max/avg/p95 values.

tasks.title: Implement LOD system with occlusion culling for generated world geometry
tasks.deliverable: Combined LOD and occlusion culling system that reduces rendered geometry based on distance and visibility from camera.
tasks.acceptance: Occluded objects behind terrain are not rendered and LOD reduces triangle count by 50% at medium distance.

tasks.title: Build degradation system: Tier 0(full) to Tier 1(-splats) to Tier 2(-post-processing) to Tier 3(minimum 30fps)
tasks.deliverable: 4-tier quality degradation system that progressively disables splats, post-processing, and effects to maintain minimum 30fps.
tasks.acceptance: When frame rate drops below 30fps, system steps down tiers until 30fps is restored, and stepping is visible in debug overlay.

tasks.title: Implement automatic recovery system (restore quality when frame budget allows)
tasks.deliverable: Recovery system that monitors sustained frame budget headroom (greater than 5ms for 30 frames) and steps up quality tier.
tasks.acceptance: After degradation to Tier 2, sustained 45fps for 1 second triggers automatic step-up to Tier 1.

tasks.title: Build PIP connection health monitor with auto-reconnect and mock data fallback
tasks.deliverable: Health monitor that detects PIP WebSocket disconnection, attempts reconnect with exponential backoff, and falls back to mock data after 3 failures.
tasks.acceptance: Disconnecting PIP triggers reconnect within 1 second, falls back to mock data after 3 failed attempts, and reconnects when PIP is restored.

tasks.title: Implement breathfield splat color palette transitions per zone proximity
tasks.deliverable: Shader system that blends breathfield splat color palettes based on proximity to zone boundaries with smooth HSL interpolation.
tasks.acceptance: Breathfield splats shift color palette smoothly when vessel moves from one zone toward another with no abrupt color changes.

tasks.title: Create PIP metrics smoothing layer (exponential moving average, 10-frame window)
tasks.deliverable: Smoothing layer applying exponential moving average over 10-frame window to all PIP metrics to prevent jittery shader/physics response.
tasks.acceptance: Raw PIP spike of 20-to-80 coherence is smoothed to gradual ramp over approximately 300ms (10 frames at 30fps).

tasks.title: Build Witness Agent stores in Zustand (aletheosFriction, pichetGravity as reactive state)
tasks.deliverable: Zustand store with aletheosFriction and pichetGravity as reactive state slices with selectors and history tracking.
tasks.acceptance: Subscribing to aletheosFriction in a React component re-renders when friction changes and history stores last 60 seconds of values.

tasks.title: Create zone transition visual test (walk N to E to W to S, verify smooth interpolation)
tasks.deliverable: Automated visual regression test that moves vessel through all 4 cardinal zone transitions and captures screenshots at boundaries.
tasks.acceptance: Test captures screenshots at each transition midpoint and all transitions show smooth interpolation with no rendering glitches.

tasks.title: Implement skybox gradient shader (Deep Ink at nadir, slightly lighter at zenith)
tasks.deliverable: GLSL skybox shader rendering a vertical gradient from deep ink black at nadir to slightly lighter ink at zenith with smooth falloff.
tasks.acceptance: Skybox renders gradient visible at all camera angles with bottom hemisphere darker than top and no banding artifacts.

tasks.title: Build shader hot-reload system (GLSL changes recompile without page refresh)
tasks.deliverable: File watcher that detects .glsl file changes and hot-swaps compiled shader programs without requiring page refresh.
tasks.acceptance: Editing a .glsl file on disk updates the rendered shader within 500ms without page reload or state loss.

tasks.title: Implement Rapier solver iteration adjustment per zone (8 velocity, 4 position for Forge)
tasks.deliverable: Per-zone physics solver configuration that adjusts Rapier velocity and position iteration counts based on zone requirements.
tasks.acceptance: Forge zone uses 8 velocity and 4 position iterations while default zones use 4 velocity and 1 position, verified via debug output.

tasks.title: Create performance regression test baseline (CI records metrics, fails on >10% regression)
tasks.deliverable: CI pipeline step that runs performance benchmark, records baseline metrics, and fails build on greater than 10% regression in any metric.
tasks.acceptance: Intentionally adding a 15% frame time regression causes the CI step to fail with a clear regression report.

tasks.title: Build zone-based physics world partitioning (separate Rapier worlds per zone)
tasks.deliverable: Physics partitioning system that creates separate Rapier worlds per spatial zone and only steps the active zone plus adjacent zones.
tasks.acceptance: Physics simulation runs only in the vessel's current zone and immediate neighbors, reducing idle zone physics CPU cost to zero.

tasks.title: Implement object transfer between zone physics worlds (maintain velocity on crossing)
tasks.deliverable: Transfer system that removes a rigid body from one zone Rapier world and recreates it in the adjacent zone with preserved velocity and rotation.
tasks.acceptance: Object thrown across a zone boundary maintains its velocity vector within 5% and does not stutter or teleport during transfer.

tasks.title: Build adaptive physics solver iterations based on frame budget pressure
tasks.deliverable: Adaptive system that reduces Rapier solver iterations when frame budget is tight and restores them when headroom is available.
tasks.acceptance: Under heavy load, solver iterations reduce from 8 to 4 and frame time decreases measurably without visible physics instability.

tasks.title: Create bio-responsive lighting: key light intensity scales with LQD, rim pulses with breath
tasks.deliverable: Lighting system where key light intensity is proportional to LQD value and rim light pulses in sync with breath phase.
tasks.acceptance: High LQD (above 80) produces bright key light, low LQD (below 30) dims it, and rim light visibly pulses at the same frequency as breath input.

tasks.title: Implement dynamic splat sorting for correct transparency rendering (depth-sorted)
tasks.deliverable: GPU-accelerated depth sorting for Gaussian splats ensuring correct transparency rendering order each frame.
tasks.acceptance: Overlapping transparent splats render in correct depth order from all camera angles with no visible sorting artifacts.

tasks.title: Build anonymized bio-data recording for session analytics (coherence/LQD averages per session)
tasks.deliverable: Backend pipeline that records anonymized aggregate bio-metrics (session averages, not raw data) to the readings table.
tasks.acceptance: After a 5-minute session, readings table contains one row with session_avg_coherence, session_avg_lqd, and session_duration fields.

tasks.title: Implement flow state detection (Aletheos coherence >70 sustained 120s to near-frictionless)
tasks.deliverable: Flow state detector that emits a flow_state_achieved event when Aletheos coherence exceeds 70 for 120 continuous seconds.
tasks.acceptance: Sustained coherence above 70 for exactly 120 seconds triggers flow_state_achieved event and sets friction to 0.3 (near-frictionless).

tasks.title: Create PIP disconnect notification (vessel flickers once on bio-data loss, stabilizes on reconnect)
tasks.deliverable: Visual notification system that flickers the vessel mesh once on PIP disconnect and smoothly stabilizes on reconnect.
tasks.acceptance: PIP disconnect causes a single visible vessel flicker within 500ms and reconnect smoothly restores stable rendering within 300ms.

tasks.title: Build coherence duration timer for Aletheos friction calculation (tracks sustained seconds >70)
tasks.deliverable: Timer component that tracks continuous seconds of coherence above 70, resets on drop below 70, and exposes duration via Zustand.
tasks.acceptance: Timer accurately counts sustained coherence above 70, resets within 1 frame of coherence dropping below 70, and value is accessible in Zustand store.

tasks.title: Implement comprehensive bio-responsive rendering integration test (vary all PIP values, verify visual+physics)
tasks.deliverable: Integration test that programmatically varies coherence, LQD, entropy, and breath_phase across full range and validates visual and physics responses.
tasks.acceptance: Test sweeps all 4 PIP values from 0 to 100 and asserts correct shader uniform values, physics damping, and post-processing intensity at each step.

tasks.title: Create Witness Agent modifier debug display (show current Aletheos friction + Pichet gravity in overlay)
tasks.deliverable: Debug overlay panel showing real-time Aletheos friction value, Pichet gravity multiplier, coherence duration, and flow state indicator.
tasks.acceptance: Debug overlay displays all 4 values updating in real-time and values match the Zustand store state within 1 frame.
